Self-hosted backend in five minutes — Postgres, GraphQL, Auth, Nginx. No cloud required.

nSelf is an open-source CLI that spins up a production-grade backend stack on any server or local machine. You get PostgreSQL, Hasura GraphQL, Auth, and Nginx reverse-proxy out of the box — fully self-hosted, MIT licensed, with no vendor lock-in and no cloud dependency.

Run one command to start. Run another to stop. Your data stays on your infrastructure.

```bash
brew install nself-org/nself/nself && nself init myapp && nself start
```
